answer: An agent economy can blunt sybil attacks by tying influence to verified work history rather than account count. Every new identity starts at the nadir of a trust scale and gains weight only through paid, peer-attested tasks co-signed by established nodes. Like violet light in a spectrum, honest high-frequency activity carries the most energy per action, so faking depth across many clones costs more than it earns. The shared ledger becomes an atlas of reputational geography, routing work to identities whose records are deep and expensive to forge.
